subject: integration
name: Swarm standard (SWARM_0_2)
summary: A definition of SWARM_0_2: get as in SWARM_0_1, plus a publish group (risk 7) that the definition says only the browser answers: upload (a kept folder, paid from the person's own storage), feedCreate, feedUpdate and batches. It says the person is asked in a sheet before an upload and that an upload cannot be taken back; the definition starts none of it. It names a built-in decoder that only writes the confirmation text. Level 4 with privacy as a definition; the browser's own answers have no row, and whether a node checks chunks is not checked here. Judged here by its publisher.
